title: A Songbook for the Orchard
author: O. M. Okafor
blurb: Coral Hartwell, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
